Role & responsibilities 
 Customer Acquisition & Sales Acquire new SA/CA/TD/Liability accounts from catchment, walk-ins & market outreach. Generate leads through cold calls, referrals, field activities, and internal databases. Drive daily/monthly sales targets and meet productivity benchmarks. Ensure quality sourcing & proper account activation as per defined guidelines. 2. Portfolio Management & Relationship Deepening Manage Classic/Preferred customer portfolios and enhance wallet share. Conduct regular customer contact to identify needs and crosssell opportunities. Prevent attrition by monitoring transactions, closures, and retaining key relationships. 3. CrossSell & Revenue Growth Crosssell Loans (PL/HL/BL/TWL), Credit Cards, Demat, MF, Insurance, and other retail products. Meet IPH benchmarks and overall branch crosssell ratios. 4. Customer Service & Complaint Resolution Deliver highquality onboarding & service experience. Resolve customer complaints within defined TAT; follow preventive complaint management. Promote digital channels (Mobile Banking, NetBanking, BillPay). 5. Branch Operations & Compliance Adhere to KYC/AML guidelines for all acquisitions & servicing. Ensure errorfree documentation, locker operations, standing instructions, and daily schedules. Support branch operations including vault/teller supervision when required. Follow audit, risk, regulatory & bank policy compliance. 6. Lead Fulfillment & CRM Management Fulfill CASA & product leads generated by all verticals. Update CRMNext/CRM tools for profiling, call planning, interactions & lead status. 7. Branch Business Support (For BMaligned responsibilities) Contribute to overall branch targets, profitability & business objectives. Support branch merchandising, customer meets & local marketing activities. Preferred candidate profile 
 Education: Any Graduate Experience: Freshers OR candidates with up to 8 years of experience in Sales, Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Fintech, Telecom, Retail or other customer-facing sales roles. Freshers with a keen interest in building a career in Sales are encouraged to apply.
